settings.layer1_body:
Radiant Life™ is a structured longitudinal documentation system.

By accessing or participating, you agree to use the system as designed — including sequencing, timing, dosage standardization, and eligibility rules — without attempting to bypass or manipulate its conditions.

The system prioritizes interpretability, fairness, and stability over convenience or speed.

Participation does not guarantee outcomes, access to specific products, continuation beyond defined system stages, or inclusion in research analysis.

settings.title: System Integrity & Participation
settings.body:
Participants agree not to: Initiate early protocol starts. Alter assigned intake mid-window. Misrepresent assessment information. Manipulate measurement inputs. Attempt to circumvent system eligibility controls.

Actions that compromise integrity may result in suspension.

settings.title: Research Participation
settings.body: Research inclusion: Is voluntary. Is separately consented. Does not alter protocol conditions. Does not provide financial benefit.

settings.title: Suspension & Termination
settings.body: Radiant Life™ reserves the right to suspend participation where: System rules are violated. Data integrity is compromised. Fraudulent manipulation is suspected.
